session_summary: Played the Treasure Run route, earning 5 coins mid-route and 25 coins upon completion, totaling 146 coins before purchases. Successfully purchased the Trail Cap (45 coins) and Moon Hood (80 coins), leaving a balance of 21 coins, which was insufficient for the 101+ coin Waypoint Crown.

observations.evidence: Completed a full Treasure Run route, gathered one small coin pickup (+5), and received the completion payout (+25), totaling 30 coins earned per run. This required buying two mid-tier items sequentially, but left the player short on the elite tier item (Waypoint Crown), ending with 21 coins.
observations.recommendation: Adjust route completion coin payouts or add intermediate coin drops within longer routes to ensure players can smoothly transition from mid-tier cosmetics to elite crown purchases without encountering an abrupt spending wall.

observations.evidence: The market action properly handled a 'Not enough coins' state when attempting to purchase 'waypoint_crown' with 21 coins, leaving coins_after unchanged at 21.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the current strict transaction safety checks while potentially adding a wishlist or saving indicator to motivate repeat runs.

feature_requests.title: Elite Cosmetic Savings Milestone Bonus
feature_requests.player_value: Rewards loyal players who accumulate funds over multiple route completions, closing the gap toward expensive items like the Waypoint Crown.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, a single successful run leaves a wide deficit when aiming for high-end marketplace items after buying mid-tier gear.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary marketplace bonus or loyalty discount tier when players retain a specific coin threshold, accelerating elite purchases.

keep: Clear transaction validation preventing negative balances during marketplace purchases.
Satisfying coin reward increments upon route completion.
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
